Automated Executive Summary

Canada-Brazil merchandise trade reached CA$14.5 BI in 2025, +16.0% versus 2024. Exports totaled CA$2.9 BI and imports reached CA$11.6 BI, leaving a trade balance of CA$-8.7 BI. The largest provincial contribution came from Ontario, while Precious Stones, Metals and Jewelry was the strongest product chapter by absolute change. The baseline outlook for 2026 implies total trade near CA$16.8 BI if current momentum and seasonal distribution persist.
